This second application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.301/2022 registered at Police Station Kotwali Betul, District Betul, for the offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(N), 315, 201,
506, 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 5/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 read with Sections 3(2)(va), 3(1)(w)(ii) of the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989.

sentences.text: The applicant's first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 07.09.2022 passed in M.Cr.C. No.43174 of 2022 granting liberty to the revive the application, if statement of prosecutrix is not recorded within a period of three months.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is in jail since 08.04.2022.
He submits that after rejection of applicant's earlier bail application, statements of prosecutrix and other material witnesses have recorded.

He submits that though the prosecutrix in her examination-in-chief has said about commission of rape with her, but later on, she in her Dipak vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129460125/
1 cross-examination has not supported the case of prosecution and said contrary to her version stated earlier in her examination-in-chief.

sentences.text: He submits that considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that the applicant being an under trial accused is in jail since 08.04.2022, he may be enlarged on bail.

On the other hand, learned Panel Lawyer has opposed the prayer of bail and submitted that when the prosecutrix in her examination-in-chief has made allegation against the applicant and alleged that he committed rape with her, the bail application deserves to be dismissed.

Considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties; perusal of case diary and the fact that the applicant being an under trial accused is in jail since 08.04.2022, I am inclined to enlarge him on bail.
Therefore, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance on the dates given by it.
It is further directed that the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

However, it is made clear that though this Court has not expressed any opinion on the merits of the case, but ultimately if trial Court comes to conclusion that the prosecutrix has not supported the case of prosecution and turned hostile, then the trial Court shall ensure recovery of amount of compensation, if any, is paid to the prosecutrix treating her to be a victim of rape under the scheme introduced by the Central Government and State Government.
Let a copy of this order be forwarded to the trial Court concerned for information and necessary compliance.

(SANJAY DWIVEDI) JUDGE Devashish DEVASHISH MISHRA 2023.01.20 16:47:28 +05'30'
